title: MVP Sprint 6 — Birthdays + Mini App Beta (2 weeks)
description:
## Sprint 6: Birthdays + Mini App Beta

**Maqsad:** Tug'ilgan kun moduli, Mini App to'liq versiyasi, beta release.

### Tasks
- [ ] Birthdays module DDD
- [ ] Birthdays schema: birthdays, birthday_reminders
- [ ] Bot wizard — tug'ilgan kun qo'shish
- [ ] pg_cron integration — every 08:00 birthday check
- [ ] 7-3-1 kun oldin eslatma sistemi
- [ ] Leap year handling (29 Feb → 28 Feb)
- [ ] Mini App full feature set (budget, tasks, reminders, birthdays)
- [ ] TMA initData server-side validation (HMAC-SHA256)
- [ ] Mini App: bottom navigation (4-5 tab)
- [ ] Mini App: TanStack Query + Zustand integration
- [ ] Mini App: offline state, loading skeleton
- [ ] JWT auth (15 min access + 7 day refresh)
- [ ] Beta release — 100 oila chaqiruvi
- [ ] Production Docker Compose + Caddy HTTPS
- [ ] DB backup (pg_dump cron)
- [ ] Load test — 100 concurrent users

**Dependencies:** Sprint 5
**Priority:** P0 — HIGH

title: MVP Sprint 5 — Reminders + Scheduler (2 weeks)
description:
## Sprint 5: Reminders + Scheduler

**Maqsad:** Eslatmalar moduli, BullMQ delayed/scheduled jobs, snooze.

### Tasks
- [ ] Reminders module DDD (domain → app → infra → presentation)
- [ ] Reminders schema: reminders, reminder_logs
- [ ] Bot wizard — eslatma yaratish (matn, kimga, vaqt, takror)
- [ ] BullMQ delayed job creation + jobId tracking
- [ ] BullMQ scheduled job — cron-based reminders
- [ ] Snooze mechanism (5 marta, +10 daqiqa)
- [ ] Reminder delivery flow (sendMessage → confirm/snooze)
- [ ] jobId DB da saqlash (server restart recovery)
- [ ] Do Not Disturb (22:00-08:00) settings
- [ ] Rate limiting — 100 job/sec, 30 reminders/month (free)
- [ ] Reminders API endpoints
- [ ] Load test — 1000 concurrent reminders

**Dependencies:** Sprint 4
**Priority:** P0 — HIGH

title: MVP Sprint 4 — Tasks + Gamification (2 weeks)
description:
## Sprint 4: Tasks + Gamification

**Maqsad:** Yumushlar moduli, ball tizimi, leaderboard, BullMQ asoslari.

### Tasks
- [ ] Tasks module DDD (domain → app → infra → presentation)
- [ ] Tasks schema: tasks, task_categories, task_logs
- [ ] Bot wizard — task yaratish, belgilash, bajarish
- [ ] BullMQ setup — queues, workers, connections
- [ ] Gamification system — points (10-50 ball)
- [ ] pg_notify: task_completed → BullMQ job
- [ ] Haftalik leaderboard (pg_cron yoki BullMQ cron)
- [ ] Oila Qahramoni e'lon qilish
- [ ] Task reminder (muddat o'tgan bildirishnoma)
- [ ] Mini App tasks page
- [ ] Tasks API endpoints
- [ ] Integration tests — task flow

**Dependencies:** Sprint 3
**Priority:** P0 — HIGH

title: MVP Sprint 3 — Budget Module (2 weeks)
description:
## Sprint 3: Budget Module

**Maqsad:** Byudjet boshqaruvi — xarajat/daromad, kategoriyalar, hisobot.

### Tasks
- [ ] Budget module DDD (domain → app → infra → presentation)
- [ ] Budget schema: transactions, categories, budgets
- [ ] Bot wizard — add income/expense (FSM)
- [ ] Kategoriyalar (8 ta default: oziq-ovqat, transport, kiyim-kechak, uy-joy, tibbiyot, ta'lim, dam olish, boshqa)
- [ ] PostgreSQL aggregate queries (hisobot)
- [ ] Redis cache — budget report (5 daqiqa TTL)
- [ ] Budget limit + overspend notification
- [ ] Hisobot ko'rish (bot text + inline keyboard)
- [ ] Mini App budget page (basic)
- [ ] Budget API endpoints (CRUD + report)
- [ ] RLS: family-scoped budget queries
- [ ] Unit tests — budget domain logic

**Dependencies:** Sprint 2
**Priority:** P0 — HIGH

title: MVP Sprint 2 — Core Bot + Family (2 weeks)
description:

description:
